items.title: ARC-005 precision monotonicity, finer 7-level ladder (breaks 848a 3-point Spearman-rho ceiling)
items.note: Measurement/test-design successor of V3-EXQ-848a (same scientific question, same substrate, same calibration dacc_goal_readout_weight=0.5/normalize=True, SAME pre-registered acceptance rule |Spearman rho|>=0.60 in >=7/10 (content x seed) units, UNSIGNED). The ONLY design delta is measurement RESOLUTION: the channel-1+2 precision ladder goes 3-level [0,0.5,1.0] -> 7-level [0/6..6/6] (70 cells: 7 levels x 2 content x 5 seeds vs 30 in 848a). Routing output of confirmed failure_autopsy_V3-EXQ-848a_2026-08-03 (REE_assembly 2c2268afad): 848a CLOSED the wiring/calibration line (channel genuinely engaged, 25,289 dACC bias calls) but scored 1/10 units on the 3-level ladder with a per-unit rho distribution ({+0.5 x6,+1.0 x1,-0.5 x2,0.0 x1}, 7/10 positive-signed) that is the arithmetic signature of a 3-point Spearman resolution ceiling (rho can only take {-1,-0.5,0,+0.5,+1} at n=3), NOT a clean null (802's genuinely-null channels gave bit-identical rho=0.0). At n=7 the H0 SD of rho is ~0.408 so the same 0.60 bar is a genuine signal threshold and is achievable by a consistent weak monotone trend, while a true null scatters near 0 (cleanly separable from a weak-real trend). Mann-Kendall two-sided p + Theil-Sen slope + Kendall tau recorded per unit as resolution-independent SECONDARY diagnostics (task-brief's 'magnitude-based statistic', honoured as continuous trend readouts NOT an absolute-floor gate: 848a's raw readouts show the real effect is ~1e-3 log10-units, swamped ~180x by the ~0.18 cross-seed SD, so the signal is in ORDERING CONSISTENCY and any principled magnitude floor would wrongly REJECT it). Plus a manifest-level resolution diagnostic (n_distinct_rho_values) as direct evidence the 3-point ceiling is broken. GOV-REUSE-1: decisive readout = |rho of log10-precision vs level| over a 7-LEVEL ladder; no recorded manifest carries it (848a is 3-level, 802/846 are different manipulations) -> not recoverable, must run. Re-derive brake: 0 substrate_ceiling autopsies tag ARC-005 -> does not fire (this is a test-design redesign, not a re-test circling a ceiling). DV-symmetry per arm: channel-1 (5-HT/calibrated dACC goal-readout) is genuinely weighted+per-candidate-set-normalised -> NOT invariant under the log10-precision DV's additive-constant/argmax or monotone-rescale/rank symmetries (a measured trend is a real measurement); channel-2 (phasic gain) is a genuine E3 softmax temperature -> argmax-invariant under the deterministic committed selection this runs under (~97% commitment), so its contribution to rho is architecturally expected NULL (unchanged by the finer ladder); channels 3/4 held fixed at L0 (SCOPE), no DV-symmetry claim. MUST run on a cloud worker (machine_class linux-x86_64-py3.10 like 848a's ree-worker-1 run) so the multinomial-sampled selection path is machine-class-matched to 848a; machine_class recorded so a Mac-landed (darwin-arm64) run can be discarded. Governance should read 848a and 848b together (848b is the resolution-corrected measurement of the same effect); does NOT invalidate 848a. Follow-on OUT OF SCOPE (report only, not chipped here): a channel-1 sub-pathway isolation (ladder dACC-consume flags alone with serotonin fixed) to attribute a positive result to the goal-readout sub-pathway vs the pre-existing serotonin pathway. Smoke: --strict validate_experiments clean; dry-run PASS end-to-end (28 dry cells all ran, dACC engaged 1148 bias calls, build-time guards held, valid manifest emitted, no traceback; dry FAIL/clamp is the expected 40-measure-tick artifact, not scored on a smoke). Queued with --allow-overlap on experiment_queue.json: genuinely different task (different EXQ id + script) from the concurrent IGW ARC-045 queue-experiment session -- both only append to the shared queue file, not duplicated work.

items.title: MECH-074 PARENT read/write-head route dissociation (write-strength vs write-address into the shared hippocampal map)
items.note: GOV-CONFIRM-1, routed from IGW-20260803-230 / chip-20260803-igw-confirm-mech074. MECH-074 has a BUILT substrate (SD-035 BLAAnalog+CeAAnalog, IMPLEMENTED 2026-04-21), lit_confidence 0.865, status candidate, v3_pending:true, and ZERO experimental entries at the PARENT granularity -- every recorded MECH-074* run tags a CHILD. SCOPE DECISION (stated per the parent/child tagging rule): this DV targets the PARENT's own shared read/write-head signature, NOT a sub-claim. The parent's own notes say it 'remains a cross-cutting umbrella' and governance should evaluate the children; the one thing that is the parent's own content is that the amygdala writes on TWO functionally separable routes into the SAME hippocampal exploration buffer and its READ is addressed by what its WRITE deposited. A single-route result evidences a child, never the parent -- so the load-bearing criterion for MECH-074 is C4 SEPARABILITY (C2 AND C3), and the script routes the parent to weakens (not supports) if one route carries all the effect. claim_ids tagged MECH-074 (C4) + MECH-074a (C3, strength route) + MECH-074b (C2, address route) with evidence_direction_per_claim, since the three can resolve differently. MECH-074b caveat recorded in the manifest: C2 tests the per-trace-VECTOR addressing half of 074b, not its central/peripheral content dissociation. WALL-INDEPENDENT: the DV is read off module state (which traces the weighted replay sample draws), not off task performance, so no scientific wall gates it. 4 arms x 3 seeds [42,43,45] (44 excluded per the standing reef-config per-seed instability finding): ARM_FULL gain2.5/tagON, ARM_TAG_OFF gain2.5/tagOFF (strength route only), ARM_GAIN_FLAT gain1.0/tagON (address route only), ARM_OFF (neither). DV = arousal over-representation in replay against a HARNESS-recorded ground-truth arousal label (peak ||z_harm_a|| per episode), NOT the substrate's own arousal_tag -- that statistic is identically 0 in a tag-ablated arm and so cannot compare arms across the address ablation. DISTINCT FROM V3-EXQ-659 (MECH-074a PASS): 659 measured ONE route and said so ('retrieval_bias is deliberately NOT supplied at readout'); this supplies retrieval_bias via the real BLA path and adds the GAIN_FLAT and TAG_OFF arms. GOV-REUSE-1: decisive readout is per-arm AOR under a gain-flat and a tag-off ablation; checked v3_exq_659_..._20260609T200751Z_v3 (only prior AOR readout -- no gain-flat/tag-off arm, AOR against the substrate tag, no retrieval_bias at readout, and NO top-level substrate_hash so compatibility is UNVERIFIABLE) and v3_exq_473/474_sd035_* (diagnostic probes, scoring_excluded, no AOR). Not recoverable -> run. Re-derive brake: 0 counted autopsies on all three claims. DV-SYMMETRY (per arm, mandatory): the DV's symmetry group is uniform positive rescaling of the weight vector (multinomial normalises) and trace permutation. No arm's manipulation is invariant under it -- both routes move weight DIFFERENTIALLY (only arousal-crossing episodes gain elevated encoding_gain or a non-zero tag), and tag-OFF collapses a non-uniform per-trace bias to all-ones, which removes non-uniformity rather than rescaling it. PRECONDITIONS are regime-conditioned via _lib/precondition_gate applies_to: strength_route_nonuniform is structurally impossible in the gain-pinned arms and address_route_nonuniform in the tag-ablated arms, so ANDing them whole-run would vacate the very arms the design compares (the V3-EXQ-785 defect); they are scoped OUT of those arms with structural_max declared, and assert_no_structurally_unsatisfiable_gate runs before any compute. SMOKE (--dry-run, 1 seed x 8 eps, ree-cloud-5): PASS, rc=0, all 4 arm gates green, all engagement checks true, AOR_z FULL 0.245 > TAG_OFF 0.186 > GAIN_FLAT 0.065 > OFF 0.004 -- the DV moves across arms (not a flat/saturated sweep) and both single routes clear the margin. THRESHOLD PROVENANCE, stated plainly: the first draft pre-registered AOR_MARGIN=0.010 in absolute ||z_harm_a|| units before the label's scale was known; the smoke revealed std ~0.051, so that margin would have falsely scored BOTH single-route arms as 'no authority'. The fix was NOT to lower the number but to standardise the statistic (AOR_z = AOR / buffer gt_arousal std, an effect size whose divisor is a property of the label distribution and is identical across arms), with AOR_Z_MARGIN=0.03 chosen from a standard-error argument at READOUT_SAMPLES=20000 (~4 SE). The smoke's weakest route (0.065) sits ~2x above that margin and the OFF-arm null at 0.004 sits ~7x below it. The smoke establishes ENGAGEMENT, not the result: 8 episodes / 1 seed is a power-poor toy and the real cohort is 40 eps x 3 seeds x 20000 draws. ARM REUSE: cells are pure functions of (substrate, config_slice, seed) and are emitted reuse-ELIGIBLE with a driver-INCLUSIVE fingerprint; no separate mint job (per the retired redundant-second-job default). Cross-driver reuse would need the OFF path factored into experiments/_lib/baselines/ -- not done, recorded as follow-on rather than claimed. ID NOTE: authored as V3-EXQ-887 and renumbered to 888 before landing -- a sibling GOV-CONFIRM-1 session (SD-014) claimed 887 in ree-v3 a638c4ff while this session's checkout was stale. Caught by the Step 5 pull/re-verify audit; nothing with the 887 id was ever pushed.

items.title: ARC-045/SD-017/MECH-166 slot-differentiation retest on repaired ContextMemory write path (gated_content_write=True); supersedes V3-EXQ-436c
items.note: ARC-045/SD-017/MECH-166 slot-differentiation retest on the REPAIRED ContextMemory write path. Discharges IGW-20260803-212 (ARC-045 pending_retest_after_substrate=true). Successor to V3-EXQ-436c: 436c was a fair, non-degenerate test whose primary DV (slot_cosine_sim differentiation, C1) FAILED 0/5 seeds and ran OPPOSITE the prediction -- SWS_THEN_REM homogenized whole-bank cosine to ~0.9999-1.0 (4/5 seeds). failure_autopsy_V3-EXQ-436c_2026-08-03 (confirmed) root-caused this to ContextMemory.write()'s write_gate acting as constant content (sigmoid-midpoint 0.5*ones) not a modulator, and its Sec.8 explicitly names THIS run: 're-run the 436-family under a new letter (e.g. V3-EXQ-436d) against the repaired write path ... once the substrate build lands -- not before.' Substrate build HAS LANDED: ree-v3 5f331fe adds ContextMemory.gated_content_write (default-OFF, bit-identical until opted in; wired through REEConfig.from_dims at 3 sites; contract test test_contextmemory_gated_content_write.py). The ONLY change vs 436c is the flag contextmemory_gated_content_write=True, held CONSTANT across both conditions (a substrate property like the noise floor); the manipulation is still sleep (SWS_THEN_REM vs WAKING_ONLY). With the homogenization confound removed, a C1 FAIL (P0 met) is now a genuine weakens and a C1 PASS genuine support -- real adjudicable signal either way. Substrate readiness EMPIRICALLY confirmed (Step 2.5a): 200-write probe at 436c operating point drives legacy off-diagonal cosine to 0.99993 (seed 2) vs 0.02487 with the flag on -- differentiation, predicted direction. GOV-REUSE-1 (Step 2.4): decisive readout (slot_cosine_sim under gated_content_write=True) is present in NO recorded manifest (flag landed 2026-08-03) -> not recoverable, must run. Re-derive brake (Step 2.5b): SD-017 count 1 (538a), ARC-045 0, MECH-166 0 -- none trip threshold 2; required substrate landed regardless. Smoke (--dry-run): both conditions wire, SWS_THEN_REM writes fire (sws_n_writes=8/rem_n_rollouts=6), slot_sim SWS 0.104 < WAKING 0.136 (no homogenization); validate_experiments.py --strict 0 findings. items.title: Q-004 tau_R calibration at larger training budget, selection-instrument fixed (supersedes V3-EXQ-149)
items.note: Q-004 replication at a larger training budget, per claims.yaml what_would_answer. GOV-REUSE-1: decisive readout not recoverable from any existing manifest -- EXQ-149 is the only prior run and cannot answer this (see defect below). Re-derive brake (2.5b): 0 failure_autopsy artifacts exist for Q-004/EXQ-149. CRITICAL FINDING during Step 3.5 code review: EXQ-149's action selection was unconditionally random.randint(...) in both training and eval, in every condition -- agent.e3.harm_eval() was trained but never consulted for selection, and residue_field.evaluate_trajectory() was never called. mean_harm under an RNG-only policy cannot depend on tau_R at ANY budget -- EXQ-149's identical-mean_harm finding is close to an arithmetic identity (DV-symmetry defect), not evidence of behavioural inertness. FIX (instrument repair, same claim/conditions/thresholds): action selection now routes through agent.hippocampal.propose_trajectories + agent.select_action (adapted from the already-reviewed V3-EXQ-120a pattern), giving tau_R two real causal channels into behavior (CEM candidate scoring vs residue terrain; E3 compute_residue_cost). Budget: WARMUP_EPISODES 300->600 (2x), EVAL_EPISODES 100->150 (1.5x) -- sized against a REAL timed calibration (10 warmup + 5 eval eps measured 32.2 sec/episode). New non-gating readiness diagnostics (R1 candidate_action_diversity>=1.5, R2 hippo_fallback_rate<0.5) guard against the fix silently degrading back to random selection. Smoke (--dry-run): all 6 cells complete, hippo_fallback_rate=0.0 everywhere, candidate_diversity_min 2.0-3.0, validate_experiments.py --strict 0 findings. Estimated ~40 hr total across 6 cells; machine_affinity=any per project convention.
